extracted.name: No Bake Granola Bars
extracted.description: These no-bake granola bars make a perfect on-the-go snack.
instruction_lines: Stir oats, peanut butter, flaxseed, honey, cranberries, chocolate chips, and almonds together in a bowl; press into a 9x11-inch baking dish, using the back of a spatula to press into a flat layer.
Cut into 12 bars and wrap each individually in plastic wrap for storage.
